title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING A REFUND OF TWO HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-TWO DOLLARS AND FIFTY CENTS ON ACCOUNT OF REAL-ESTATE TAX COLLECTED IN THE CITY OF MANILA FROM MARIA ARGUELLES THROUGH A CLERICAL ERROR OF THE COLLECTING AUTHORITIES.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING A REFUND OF TWO HUNDRED AND SEVENTY-TWO DOLLARS AND FIFTY CENTS ON ACCOUNT OF REAL-ESTATE TAX COLLECTED IN THE CITY OF MANILA FROM MARIA ARGUELLES THROUGH A CLERICAL ERROR OF THE COLLECTING AUTHORITIES.

text.en:
The City Assessor and Collector of the city of Manila in hereby authorized to refund to Maria
Arguelles the sum of two hundred and seventy-two, dollars and fifty cents, United States currency, collected
from her as real-estate tax on certain property in the district of Santa Cruz in excess of the amount actually
due by reason of a clerical error in the office of the City Assessor and Collector, and this sum is hereby
appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, and shall be properly
charged to the revenues of the city of Manila.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act proscribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, August 24, 1903.
